stem: Larry has 14 oranges. He will cut each of these oranges into 7 slices. Which array can be used to find the number of orange slices he will have?

options.label: A
options.text: (emoji cluster representing 14 rows of 7 slices each)

options.label: B
options.text: (emoji cluster representing 7 slices in the first row and 14 slices in the second row)

options.label: C
options.text: (emoji cluster representing 7 slices in a single row)

options.label: D
options.text: (emoji cluster representing 14 slices in a single row)

visual_elements: A: array of 14 rows by 7 slices, B: array with first row 7 slices, second row 14 slices, C: array with 7 slices in one row, D: array with 14 slices in one row
difficulty_rationale: This problem requires simple multiplication understanding and recognition of the correct array arrangement for 14 times 7, which is a direct representation of the problem context.
